horizontalApps.name: External-Send QC
horizontalApps.what: Final gate on every external artifact: recipients, attachments, code names, metadata, Reg FD / FINRA 2210

horizontalApps.name: Pipeline CRM
horizontalApps.what: Single firm-wide funnel (live lead → won/lost/hold/terminated/died) — moved here (firm-wide, not one stage)

horizontalApps.name: Work-Check
horizontalApps.what: Checks every agent output before a senior banker sees it (consistency, citations, numbers, code-name map)

horizontalApps.name: Sector Intelligence
horizontalApps.what: Maintains comps, precedents, market maps, competitive quadrants; monthly refresh

horizontalApps.name: Multi-Model Verification
horizontalApps.what: 2+ independent models cross-check consequential outputs; discrepancies escalate

horizontalApps.name: Expert Panel Review
horizontalApps.what: Static + deal-specific panels red-team consequential work product

horizontalApps.name: Continuous Learning / Skill Optimization
horizontalApps.what: Captures deal patterns/edits; proposes prompt & template improvements

horizontalApps.name: Deal Workflow Coordinator
horizontalApps.what: Routes tasks, holds deal-state, monitors SLA, aggregates dashboard

horizontalApps.name: Document Retention + Permission Cross-Check
horizontalApps.what: Retention/permission tagging; dual-control deletions (FINRA 4511 / SEC 17a-3/4)

horizontalApps.name: License / U4 / CE Compliance Tracker
horizontalApps.what: Tracks each banker's FINRA license, U4, CE; alerts the bank's (Chief Compliance Officer/CCO)

horizontalApps.name: MD-Style Review
horizontalApps.what: Applies the named MD's approved voice before MD review

horizontalApps.name: Knowledge Graph / Relationship Strength
horizontalApps.what: Who-knows-whom graph, scored; warm-path discovery

horizontalApps.name: Negotiation Copilot
horizontalApps.what: Counter-positions + precedent for ELs, NDAs, LOIs, definitive terms

horizontalApps.name: Workflow Monitoring
horizontalApps.what: Opt-in; surfaces repetitive patterns as new agent candidates

horizontalApps.name: File Storage Reorganization
horizontalApps.what: Reorganizes SharePoint/Drive with permissions preserved

horizontalApps.name: Fee Structure Pool
horizontalApps.what: Anonymized cross-firm fee benchmarks — platform only

horizontalApps.name: Enterprise Search
horizontalApps.what: Permission-aware search and Q&A across the firm's documents, emails, and deal records; every query respects deal walls and is logged

horizontalApps.name: Model Optimization
horizontalApps.what: Routes each task to the most cost-effective model that clears the quality bar; tracks AI spend by user, deal, and task

horizontalApps.name: Data Room Hosting
horizontalApps.what: Hosted, permissioned data-room layer (Box) with tagging, staged access, and AI-readable APIs, sitting above SharePoint

horizontalApps.name: Communication Checking
horizontalApps.what: Communications compliance layer (Global Relay / Smarsh): capture, archiving, and surveillance of business communications

horizontalApps.name: Staffing
horizontalApps.what: Assigns bankers and agents to mandates and tracks deal-team capacity across live deals

steps.name: Target Universe
steps.description: Defines priority sectors/targets, exit triggers, buyer themes

steps.name: Exit Readiness
steps.description: Scores which companies are most likely to sell, and when

steps.name: Acquirer Strategy
steps.description: Identifies likely buyers and likely targets per buyer

steps.name: Lead Registration
steps.description: Registers every lead \<24h with source, type, size, owner

steps.name: Source Intelligence
steps.description: Captures referrer/supporter intel: goals, criteria, competing banks

steps.name: Conflicts Checklist
steps.description: Conflicts / restricted-list / prior-engagement check before private info

steps.name: Codename / Deal Shell
steps.description: Assigns code name, deal shell, access list, confidentiality

steps.name: Relationship Pathing
steps.description: Maps decision-makers, board/investors, warm paths, introducers

steps.name: MD Briefing + Company Backgrounding
steps.description: One doc: MD brief + sourced company profile + relevant case studies

steps.name: Meeting Intelligence
steps.description: AI-notes consent; structured capture of first calls

steps.name: Deal Qualification
steps.description: Scores mandate fit (fee, likelihood, fit, conflicts) → go/no-go

steps.name: Client NDA Workflow
steps.description: Prepares/tracks client NDA before requesting private documents

steps.name: Initial Diligence Request List
steps.description: Drafts first diligence request list post-NDA, from sector templates

steps.name: Outreach Strategy
steps.description: Per-person approach: narrative, angle, objections, sequence

steps.name: Strategy / SWOT
steps.description: SWOT, strategic alternatives, why-sell-now, valuation drivers

steps.name: Stakeholder Psychology
steps.description: Maps each stakeholder's decision style, anxieties, objections

steps.name: Buyer Universe
steps.description: Strategic + sponsor universe: rationale, ability/likelihood to pay; universe drafted here, approved buyer list finalized during Phase 2 preparation

steps.name: Case Study Library
steps.description: Surfaces 3–5 most-relevant prior deals for the pitch (spans pipeline → pitch prep)

steps.name: Engagement Economics
steps.description: Fee structure, retainer, success fee, tail vs. precedent

steps.name: Engagement Letter Strategy
steps.description: Drafts Engagement Letter (EL) structure and key provisions (internal strategy)

steps.name: Pitchbook Drafting
steps.description: Pitch deck in firm template + league-table rankings + case studies

steps.name: Pitch Page QC
steps.description: Page-by-page QC: point, story, sources, numbers, formatting

steps.name: Pitch Rehearsal
steps.description: Roles, page owners, likely objections, Q&A, dry-run

steps.name: Pitch Follow-Up
steps.description: Debrief, stakeholder follow-ups, promised deliverables

steps.name: Engagement Negotiation
steps.description: Sends/negotiates EL, redlines, tracks signature

steps.name: Mandate Activation Checklist
steps.description: Converts prospect → mandate: conflicts, EL, W9, team, permissions

steps.name: Win/Loss Debrief
steps.description: Mandatory debrief on every pitch outcome (won or lost)

steps.name: Kickoff / Org Meeting
steps.description: Org meeting → initial WGL, milestones, roles, cadence

steps.name: Timeline
steps.description: Builds + tracks the transaction timeline vs. baseline

steps.name: WGL
steps.description: Working Group List, buyer-segregated visibility

steps.name: VDR Setup
steps.description: Data-room architecture, permissions, clean-team folders

steps.name: Document Intake / Metadata
steps.description: Folder/naming/metadata hygiene, draft/final tagging

steps.name: Data Room Diligence
steps.description: Reviews data room for gaps, risks, MNPI (material non-public information), red flags

steps.name: Financial Normalization
steps.description: Normalizes financials, ARR bridge, EBITDA, add-backs

steps.name: Deal Pulse Checklist
steps.description: Daily/weekly pulse: overdue items, priorities, blockers, risk-to-signing; produces the recurring weekly client update

steps.name: Teaser
steps.description: Anonymized teaser / blind profile

steps.name: CIM / Management Presentation
steps.description: Confidential Information Memorandum (CIM) / management presentation from approved data

steps.name: FAQ&A
steps.description: Anticipated buyer FAQ&A, continuously updated

steps.name: Outreach Sequencing
steps.description: Segments buyers into waves; owners, scripts, cadence

steps.name: Buyer Synergies Model + Valuation
steps.description: Per-buyer synergies + accretion/dilution + ability/willingness to pay

steps.name: Buyer Log / Feedback
steps.description: Logs every buyer touch + pass reasons into CRM; feedback loop

steps.name: Buyer NDA
steps.description: Tracks buyer NDA status, redlines, VDR-access readiness

steps.name: Buyer VDR Access
steps.description: Staged VDR access, watermarking, logs — platform only

steps.name: Management Meeting
steps.description: Buyer-specific decks, coaching, post-meeting summaries

steps.name: Buyer Q&A
steps.description: Manages buyer questions, sourced answers, FAQ updates

steps.name: LOI / Process Letter
steps.description: Process letters / LOI forms, bid instructions, deadlines

steps.name: Bid Comparison
steps.description: Compares IOIs (first-round offers)/bids on price, structure, certainty, fit

steps.name: LOI Review
steps.description: LOI/exclusivity issues, negotiation points, decision memo

steps.name: Merger Agreement Distribution
steps.description: Distributes form agreement; tracks comments/issues

steps.name: Definitive Agreement Support
steps.description: Confirmatory diligence, disclosure schedules, closing conditions; includes board approval of the transaction (pre-signing)

steps.name: Signing / Announcement Prep
steps.description: Signing checklist, announcement + press/tombstone drafts

steps.name: Announcement
steps.description: Coordinates release timing, materials, approvals

steps.name: LinkedIn Post
steps.description: Pre-staged deal post, released at announcement timestamp

steps.name: Email Blast
steps.description: Pre-staged announcement email to firm/relationships/prospects

steps.name: League Table Submission
steps.description: Submits the deal to every league-table/aggregator on announcement; monitors post-close correction cycles

steps.name: Regulatory Approval Tracker
steps.description: Tracks HSR/antitrust, consents, deadlines (runs signing → closing)

steps.name: Closing Checklist
steps.description: Closing deliverables, funds flow, wires, signatures (anti-fraud checks)

steps.name: Fee Realization / Invoice
steps.description: Calculates fee, generates invoice, attaches EL, drafts client email

steps.name: Closing Compliance Checklist / Binder
steps.description: Compiles the closing binder + compliance evidence package

steps.name: Post-Close Fee Monitor
steps.description: Tracks earnouts, escrow releases, milestone/contingent fees

steps.name: Relationship Follow-Up (closing dinner)
steps.description: Closing dinner, thank-yous, references, referral asks

steps.name: Transaction Marketing / Asset Library
steps.description: Tombstone, website, reusable materials harvesting

steps.name: Earned / Paid Publication
steps.description: Earned-media/byline within 48h of announcement

steps.name: Deal Learning / Post-Mortem
steps.description: Debrief → updates skills, buyer scores, playbooks

steps.name: Tail Rights & Termination Monitor
steps.description: Tracks tail period, fee triggers, termination; updates funnel
